newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Tung welcomes Kiribati's visa waiver.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tung welcomes Kiribati's visa waiver.

text.p: Hong Kong's future leader Tung Chee-hwa on Thursday welcomed a decision by the Pacific island state of Kiribati to waive visa requirements for Hong Kong passport holders after the territory's handover to China.
The territory will start issuing Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) passports after Britain ends 156 years of colonial rule and hands Hong Kong back to China at midnight on June 30.
"The Kiribati government has made a very welcome decision in granting visa-free access to holders of Hong Kong SAR passports after July 1," Tung said in a statement.
So far, some 30 countries -- including Britain, Singapore, Canada, and the Philippines -- have promised either visa-free or easy access for holders of the future Hong Kong passports.
